subject.title: fix(agent): stale replies after queued user turns

question: Should OpenClaw canonicalize this PR's preserve-as-context repair for metadata-hidden queued user turns, or prefer the stale-internal-drop semantics proposed in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/96533?
rationale: Both open PRs target the same canonical issue but encode different session-state semantics; the code review can judge this PR viable, but cannot decide the product contract for older queued user turns versus internal stale handoffs.

options.title: Adopt this PR's repair
options.body: Land this PR after exact-head refresh if maintainers accept preserving the older queued user turn as context while answering the latest active prompt.

options.title: Require a combined repair
options.body: Ask for a follow-up that keeps this metadata-hidden orphan search while also adding an owner-approved provenance/drop rule for internal handoffs.

options.title: Prefer the alternate PR
options.body: Pause or close this branch only if https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/96533 or another replacement gets sufficient live proof and owner sign-off.
